title: Scenes exported as glTF that contain any hidden geometry can't be opened by Blender
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in Godot 4.5 stable, with Blender 4.5.3 LTS.


### System information

Godot v4.5.stable (876b29033) - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Single-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7602) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-14900KF (32 threads) - 63.83 GiB memory

### Issue description

When you save a scene as glTF and it contains any hidden geometry, Blender fails to open the file with the error message: "Extension KHR_node_visibility is not available on this addon version".

### Steps to reproduce

Create a scene in Godot with a MeshInstance3D (with a Box3D as geometry). Hide it in the scene. From the menu choose "Scene > Export As... > glTF 2.0 Scene..." and save it to a file. Then start Blender and import that file. You will get the above error message.

The solution is to save the file with the GLTFDocument.VISIBILITY_MODE_INCLUDE_OPTIONAL flag. Arguably, for compatibility, that should have probably been the default.

So the following GDScript code will work:

```
	var gltf_document_save := GLTFDocument.new()
	var gltf_state_save := GLTFState.new()
	gltf_document_save.visibility_mode = GLTFDocument.VISIBILITY_MODE_INCLUDE_OPTIONAL
	gltf_document_save.append_from_scene(get_tree().root, gltf_state_save)
	gltf_document_save.write_to_filesystem(gltf_state_save, "scene.glb")
```
